name: Teman
title: Esau's Grandson and Edomite Tribal Father
summary: Teman was the firstborn son of Eliphaz, who in turn was the son of Esau. He became the tribal father of one of the most important clans in Edom, and his name was used for an entire region and people in southern Edom. Teman is also known through the biblical wisdom tradition, as Eliphaz from Teman was one of Job's three friends.

keyEvents.title: The Birth and Lineage of Teman
keyEvents.description: Teman was born as the firstborn son of Eliphaz, the son of Esau, and is listed in Esau's genealogy.

keyEvents.title: Chieftain in Edom
keyEvents.description: Teman became one of the chieftains (princes) of Edom and founded one of the most important clans among the Edomite people.

keyEvents.title: Teman in Edom's Family History
keyEvents.description: In 1 Chronicles, Teman's place in Esau's genealogy is repeated, confirming his significance as a patriarch in Edom's history.

keyEvents.title: Teman's Wisdom Mentioned by Jeremiah
keyEvents.description: The prophet Jeremiah mentions Teman's wisdom in his prophecy against Edom and asks whether wisdom has vanished from Teman—showing that the region was known for its wise men.

keyEvents.title: God's Judgment on Teman
keyEvents.description: The prophet Amos proclaims God's judgment on Teman and Bozrah because of Edom's sin against Israel, warning of fire over Teman's palaces.

keyEvents.title: God's Coming from Teman in Habakkuk's Song
keyEvents.description: In the prophet Habakkuk's prayer, God is described as coming from Teman, pointing to His powerful presence and glory that fills the heavens.
